I’ve been using scar gel and doing massages, but it still bothers me a little.
Doctor: Could you describe the lump you noticed under your left breast in more detail, such as its size, shape, consistency, and whether it was painful or tender? Additionally, have you had any imaging or evaluation of this lump previously?
